meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会接入 GitHub 的 PR 和 issue 评论线程:有人 @ 机器人账号时它在评论区回复,该线程之后的评论也会继续回应。需要先配好专用机器人账号、细粒度令牌和仓库 webhook。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论中 @ 到机器人账号时接管;首次被 @ 后该线程被订阅,后续评论都会由它回应。

say.text: @my-org-bot 这个 PR 改了什么?帮我总结一下
say.note: 在 PR 评论里 @ 机器人,它在评论区回复

say.text: @my-org-bot 这个 issue 该怎么复现和排查?
say.note: 在 issue 评论线程里提问

say.text: @my-org-bot 针对这条评审意见给出修改建议
say.note: 线程被订阅后会继续回应后续评论

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude joins GitHub PR and issue comment threads: when someone @-mentions the bot account it replies in the thread and keeps answering follow-ups. Needs a dedicated bot account, a fine-grained token and webhooks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment; after the first mention the thread is subscribed and later comments are answered too.

say_en.text: @my-org-bot what changed in this PR? Summarize it for me
say_en.note: Ask in a PR comment thread; it replies there

say_en.text: @my-org-bot how should I reproduce and debug this issue?
say_en.note: Ask in an issue comment thread

say_en.text: @my-org-bot suggest fixes for this review comment
